description: Optimal SARSA hyperparameters found via grid search (alpha, gamma, epsilon sweeps on A1_grid and large_grid)

tuning_rationale.alpha: 0.1 gives best return; 0.01 too slow, 0.3+ slightly worse due to instability
tuning_rationale.gamma: 0.95 needed for long paths (28 steps on A1_grid); 0.6-0.8 fail to propagate reward
tuning_rationale.epsilon: fixed 0.05 best; low exploration sufficient with BFS shaping guiding the agent
tuning_rationale.shaping: BFS potential-based shaping eliminates sparse reward problem, enables fast convergence
